title: ByteGAN: 256-Mode 8D Binary Hypercube Codebook
intuition: Tests exact discrete atomic bijection on all 256 uniform uint8 bytes encoded at the corners of {-1, +1}^8 using an exact-capacity 256-particle zero-sigma prior: requires 256/256 unique valid bytes, zero collisions, and rms_bit_error <= 0.12.
failure_mode: Without atomic bijection support, streaming prototype priors suffer collisions and collapse to ~139/256 unique bytes (as historically observed on `unified-v12` before opt-in `feydy_atomic`).
protocol_notes: Tier-2 stretch task and Four Laws Adherence Law 1 anchor (4,000 updates, zero-sigma 256-particle prior).
